all-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，阿尔本加国际机场（ALL）的跑道嵌在绿色植被与农田之间。
all-sat-1.webp.en: On the satellite image, the runway at Riviera Villanova d'Albenga International Airport (ALL) sits between green vegetation and farmland.

all-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰，阿尔本加机场的跑道嵌在绿色谷地里，旁边是卵石河床，远处是连绵山峦。
all-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Seen from the air, Albenga's runway sits in a green valley beside a broad pebble riverbed, with mountain ridges rising beyond the field.

all-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 阿尔本加机场红白相间的塔台从低矮航站楼后方升起，楼前矮墙上的 ALBENGA 字样清晰可读。
all-chatgpt-02.webp.en: The red and white control tower rises behind a low terminal building, with the name ALBENGA lettered on the wall in front and mountains beyond.

all-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 暮色中，两架公务机停在阿尔本加机场的混凝土停机坪上，身后是玻璃幕墙的航站楼。
all-chatgpt-03.webp.en: At dusk two business jets stand on the concrete apron of Albenga airport, with a glass-fronted terminal building behind them.

all-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 傍晚的阿尔本加机场，一架白黄涂装的轻型单发螺旋桨飞机停在停机坪上，远处是黛色山峦。
all-chatgpt-04.webp.en: In the evening light at Albenga a small white and yellow single-engine propeller aircraft stands on the apron, dark mountains beyond.

all-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 从空中望去，阿尔本加机场的跑道与大片草地夹在公路和河道之间，远处是海岸城镇。
all-chatgpt-05.webp.en: From the air the Albenga runway and its wide grass field lie between a road and a riverbed, with the coastal town and sea in the distance.

all-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 阿尔本加机场的停机坪上，一架直升机停在白色帐篷式机库前，蓝天上飘着成团的白云。
all-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A helicopter rests on the apron in front of a white tent hangar at Albenga, under a blue sky filled with puffy clouds.
